snippet.title: ¡IMPACTADOS! Medios de ITALIA y LATINOAMÉRICA reaccionan al 2º día del papa LEÓN XIV en PERÚ
snippet.description:
¡La visita del papa León XIV al Perú está acaparando la atención de la prensa internacional! Medios de ARGENTINA, ITALIA, MÉXICO, ESPAÑA y COLOMBIA reaccionan a su llegada y destacan los acontecimientos de esta histórica visita, que está poniendo al Perú en el centro de la atención mundial.

En su segundo día en territorio peruano, medios de Italia y Latinoamérica siguen de cerca cada acontecimiento de esta histórica visita, que está poniendo al Perú en el centro de la atención internacional.

Pero detrás de este acontecimiento hay cifras que llaman especialmente la atención: el turismo, la hotelería, los restaurantes, el transporte, el comercio y miles de pequeños negocios podrían beneficiarse de la llegada de visitantes nacionales y extranjeros.

💰 ¿CUÁNTO DINERO PUEDE GENERAR LA VISITA DEL PAPA?

Las estimaciones del Ministerio de Comercio Exterior y Turismo apuntan a un movimiento económico de aproximadamente S/300 millones. Por su parte, otras proyecciones empresariales sitúan el impacto potencial en cifras todavía mayores.

Además, se estima que alrededor de 850.000 turistas se movilizarán por las ciudades incluidas en el recorrido papal, mientras que más de 3 millones de personas participarán en las actividades del Santo Padre.

📊 ¿Y CÓMO SE COMPARA CON ARGENTINA Y URUGUAY?

Las proyecciones económicas también son millonarias en los países vecinos:

🇵🇪 PERÚ: Se proyecta un movimiento económico de S/300 millones a nivel nacional, según Mincetur.

🇦🇷 ARGENTINA: Se estima un movimiento potencial de aproximadamente US$270 millones por el consumo de visitantes que llegarían para participar en las actividades papales.

🇺🇾 URUGUAY: La organización de la visita contempla un presupuesto estimado de entre US$2 y US$3 millones, financiado mediante colectas, donaciones, una rifa y aportes institucionales.

🏨 Hoteles, restaurantes, agencias de viajes, transportistas, comerciantes, artesanos y emprendedores están entre los sectores que pueden recibir los beneficios de este movimiento.

¿Estamos ante una de las visitas papales con mayor impacto económico y turístico para el Perú?

Acompáñanos a conocer cómo reaccionan los medios internacionales y por qué la visita de León XIV está generando tanta atención dentro y fuera de nuestras fronteras.

🇵🇪 ¡EL PERÚ ESTÁ EN LOS OJOS DEL MUNDO!

Every night, for a few hours, you disappear. No thoughts. No time. No you. And every morning you wake up without ever noticing you were gone.
So what exactly is the thing that switches off? And what happens to it when you die?

What if the moment you die isn’t the moment your brain falls silent — but the moment it burns brighter than it ever has?
At the University of Michigan, scientists were recording the brain of a collapsing 24-year-old woman in the minutes after her family agreed to switch off life support. What the EEG picked up in her final seconds was the exact opposite of what everyone in that room expected.
And that’s only the beginning.

This isn’t a video about the afterlife. It’s real patients, real recordings and real experiments — and a question about your own existence that only gets harder the closer science looks at it.
Watch till the end. The final answer isn’t about dying at all. It’s about what your brain is doing, right now, to keep you here.

snippet.title: He Can't Keep Getting Away With THIS...
snippet.description:
He can’t keep doing this… The Wizards and the Pistons battled in a double overtime thriller… 
And Lamelo Ball took Cooper Flagg to school… Just 4 games on a Thursday night but a lot of exciting ones so let’s start with the thriller in Detroit between the Pistons and the Wizards. Both teams were trading blocks, alleyoop jams… Timely shots by their main guys, you name it… So, we’re entering the clutch with the Pistons up by 4 points and Ausar Thompson’s great defensive instincts. Ausar gets the block on one end and then saves the ball on the other which brings the Pistons a 6 point lead. Then, Trae Young makes the defense collapse on the penetration before kicking the ball out to Sarr for the splash. The Wizards took one more point off the deficit when Ausar failed to answer Trae’s free throws in the clutch, setting the stage up for this. Sarr finds the wide open George up top who nails the 3 to take over the lead and send the fans into a delirium. Needing a stop, the Wizards weren't gonna give Cade anything easy, even if they had to bleed for it. Ooohh AJ got the short end of the stick on that collision with Cade. A mouthful of blood for Dybantsa and a couple of free throws for Cunningham, who stays collected and nails both to get back on top. And here’s everything that’s wrong with the Wizards in one play. Trae Young still wants to play hero ball like he used to do in Atlanta… 
Cade doesn’t bite on Trae’s clumsiness and puts his team in a great position to win it all.
He gets fouled with 1.8 seconds on the clock and prolongs to hit both free throws like it’s practice and not a do or die scenario on the road. So, down by 3 let’s see if Young can redeem himself… Maan, just when you think it’s over he’s gonna pull an ace out of his sleeve and shock everybody! To be completely fair though, Trae had a pretty nice game till that point, going toe to toe with Cunningham. And pumped up from his heroics, the Wizards struck first in OT. Washington goes on a 7-0 blitz to start the extra period, forcing Detroit to activate code red. 
The Pistons returned the blow with a 6-0 run of their own to get right back into it. So, with the entire arena on its feet, Trae and AD make ‘em explode!
Young even had a chance to make it a 2 possession game right here but he and Coulabaly misunderstood each other, so the punishment arrived quickly! 
Cunningham silenced the crowd with his 47th point of the night and things kept getting worse for the Wizards because… Robinson nails another 3 off Trae’s miss and now all of a sudden the Pistons have a 3 point lead with 9 seconds on the clock. Or so they thought so… You see, with the latest Court IQ technology, it appears that the shadow of Duncan’s shoe is touching the line which overturned the 3 into a 2 pointer. The Pistons bench clearly wasn’t approving of that, ‘cuz if you judge solely by the replay it looks like a 3 for Christ sake.. Anyway, the Wizards were put to the test once again. Can they come up with another miracle?
My goodness, the rookie sends the game into double overtime after a lousy 1 of 8 shooting thus far. What a rollercoaster of a game! (2rata poubava repriza od utakmicata)
So, it was Detroit’s time to serve the 1st punch! Ausar was all over the place last night, posting a triple double to go along with his 3 blocks and steals! That’s phenomenal! 
On the other end, Alex Sarr had himself a ball game as well, cutting the deficit to just 3 with his 30th point of the night right here. And he came up with a crucial stop on defense. First by rejecting Reed’s attempt and then by winning the jump ball for his team. Down 4 with less than 80 seconds left, Trae tries a risky pass… Geez the Wizards just won’t go away. And after another great defense by Sarr, they even had a chance to go up by 1 when…
This is it, time winding down, you want the ball in the hands of your best player. It’s go time!
Cunningham puts Detroit on his shoulders in the clutch and with his 52nd point of the night gives them a 2 possession lead. This has to be enough for the win right…? Well…

snippet.title: Mithai Mein STARCH Aur Fake Silver?! Test Karke Dekho 😳
snippet.description:
Mithai dekhne mein premium.

Upar silver varq.

Price bhi premium.

Lekin andar kya hai? 😳

FSSAI khud simple adulteration-screening tests publish karta hai for milk products, sweets and silver leaf.

Is video mein food hygiene se lekar peda iodine test, fake silver varq, ketchup labels, protein-oats claims, paneer texture and food-storage myths tak multiple things check ki gayi hain.

🍬 PEDA / MITHAI + IODINE TEST

FSSAI’s DART method says starch adulteration in milk products such as:

• khoya
• chhena
• paneer

can be screened using iodine.

Method:

Sample ko water ke saath prepare karo, cool karo and iodine add karo.

Blue / purple colour = starch present.

Important:

Iodine test detects starch.

It does NOT automatically tell you:

• why starch is present
• how much is present
• whether every product from that shop is adulterated

So if a Mathura peda or another milk sweet turns blue in a properly conducted test, it is a legitimate red flag for starch.

🥈 CHANDI VARQ OR ALUMINIUM?

FSSAI requires edible silver leaf to be at least:

999/1000 silver purity.

FSSAI consumer guidance also gives a simple rough screening clue:

Pure silver leaf is extremely delicate and tends to crumble/disappear when rubbed.

Aluminium is tougher and may leave foil-like shreds.

Lab confirmation is still better, but fake silver varq is a real adulteration issue.

🍅 KISSAN “100% REAL TOMATOES”

A current Kissan Tomato Ketchup label lists roughly:

Tomato paste — 28%

along with:

• water
• sugar
• salt
• acidity regulator
• stabilisers
• preservative
• spices

So “made with 100% real tomatoes” should NOT be read as:

“100% of the ketchup is tomato.”

It means the tomato ingredient itself is presented as real tomato rather than synthetic tomato substitute.

That distinction matters.

🥣 YOGA BAR 26g PROTEIN OATS

This is another label-reading point where the script needs correction.

Yoga Bar High Protein Oats lists approximately:

26 g protein per 100 g

So a 50 g serving gives around:

13 g protein.

That is mathematically consistent.

It is NOT misleading if the nutrition panel clearly states that the 26 g value is per 100 g.

Always check:

Per serving vs per 100 g.

🍊 PACKAGED JUICE COLOUR TEST

A packaged orange drink reacting differently from freshly squeezed orange juice does not automatically prove it is “fake”.

Packaged juices/drinks can contain:

• processed fruit concentrate
• acidity regulators
• stabilisers
• permitted colours/flavours
• added sugar, depending on the product

A household cleaning-liquid reaction is not a validated food-authenticity test.

Read the label first.

🥥 COCONUT WATER / CREAM COMPLAINTS

A black fungal-looking growth, curdling, swelling, bad smell or foreign material in a packaged food/drink should be treated seriously.

El Señor de los Cielos 10
Aurelio Casillas, tras el asesinato de Mecha y el secuestro de su hija Rutila, se obsesiona con el poder absoluto. Para reconstruir su imperio criminal, recorre México y Estados Unidos, forja alianzas inestables y revive viejos conflictos. El asesinato de uno de sus hijos desata una violenta sed de venganza que lo hace aún más despiadado y sus acciones fracturan lazos familiares, lo que provoca la resistencia de las mujeres que antes dominaba.

After the murder of Mecha and the kidnapping of his daughter Rutila, Aurelio Casillas becomes obsessed with absolute power. To rebuild his criminal empire, he travels across Mexico and the United States, forges unstable alliances and rekindles old conflicts. The murder of one of his sons unleashes a violent thirst for revenge that makes him even more ruthless, and his actions fracture family ties, provoking resistance from the women he once controlled.
